Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the
Topic 3.5: Caring For Energy environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Caring For Energy environment

• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Caring For Energy environment
2. give Kenyan examples of Caring For Energy environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Caring For Energy environment

Teach
• Observe Caring For Energy environment in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Caring For Energy environment (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Caring For Energy environment.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Caring For Energy environment.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Caring For Energy environment.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Caring For Energy environment.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Caring For Energy environment: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Caring For Energy environment with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
